title: First-brief retirement refusal misdescribes an already-finished delegation, a missing child, and a requester takeover whose turn was never admitted
acceptance: Each of the three branches returns wording that matches what happened, and none tells the caller to wait on an evaluator that will never run.
A test per branch, built on the FirstBriefAckWriter fixture in src/tests/acceptance_evaluation_spawn_ack.rs, pins the response.
